toolsPreview.name: get_site_info
toolsPreview.description: Facts about blicht.com, the bilingual (German/English) knowledge platform for e-commerce, AI and lifestyle: publisher, contact, entry points for further reading and how to fetch pages efficiently as Markdown.

toolsPreview.name: list_topics
toolsPreview.description: The content map of blicht.com: 3 sections (e-commerce, AI, lifestyle) with their fixed topics, each with a description and the URL of its overview page.

toolsPreview.name: search_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across all blicht.com content (articles, section and topic pages) in German or English. Returns the most relevant pages with title, URL and description so you can cite them. Read-only. Fetch a hit's full text via get_article or by requesting its URL with 'Accept: text/markdown'.

toolsPreview.name: get_article
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full text of a blicht.com article as clean Markdown. Accepts the article URL (https://blicht.com/beitrag/<slug> or /en/article/<slug>), the path, or a bare slug (combined with lang). Use search_knowledge first to find the right article.
